newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's GOCTIC closes US$50 million FRN.
newsitem.headline: China's GOCTIC closes US$50 million FRN.

text.p: Guangdong Overseas Chinese Trust and Investment Corp's US$50 million floating rate note issue has closed, bankers said.
The US$20 million tranche A has a final maturity of three years. It pays a coupon of 55 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate and a selling concession of 65 basis points.
The US$15 million tranche B has a final maturity of four years and pays a coupon of 60 basis points. The selling concession is 70 basis points.
The remaining US$15 million tranche C has a final maturity of five years and pays a coupon of 65 basis points. The selling concession is 75 basis points.
Fees are 65 basis points for co-arrangers and co-lead managers, 60 basis points for senior managers and 55 basis points for managers.
Lenders with US$7 million each, are BZW Asia, Commerz East Asia, Korea Development Bank, and Sakura Finance Asia.
Participating banks with US$5 million each, are Asian Banking Corp and Industrial Bank of Korea Hong Kong.
Other participating banks with US$3 million each, are China Merchant Bank, Guandong Development Bank (Macau), ICBC (Guangzhou) and Kwangju Bank.
